blurb: Guests take narrated helicopter flights over scenic locations such as Orange County coastline, Los Angeles landmarks, and the Grand Canyon. Some tours combine helicopter flights with ground tours like Hummer rides. Flights use helicopters like the Robinson R44 and Airbus EC-130, providing aerial views of beaches, cityscapes, and natural landmarks.
